ideas.pitch: An AI-powered indoor mapping and workspace allocation tool optimized for managing crowd flow and event spaces during college fests like Synergia.
ideas.title: Sahyadri Campus Flow & Space Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a real operational challenge for the organizing community (SOSC) during a major fest like Synergia, making it immediately practical for the organizers.

ideas.pitch: A software platform enabling colleges to track, audit, and forecast institutional carbon footprints, recycling metrics, and power usage.
ideas.title: GreenCampus Energy and Waste Audit Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning green-tech and data forecasting model by providing actionable analytics and dashboards that institutional authorities care about.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight medical triage web portal featuring rPPG heart rate detection via webcam and multi-lingual student health symptom logging for campus clinics.
ideas.title: CampusMed AI Triage & Health Log
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates advanced browser-based computer vision capabilities (rPPG/OpenCV) that impress judges through working, interactive browser demos.

ideas.pitch: A collaborative multi-agent student learning platform using RAG to ingest lecture slides and generate personalized revision roadmaps and quizzes.
ideas.title: EduScribe AI Multi-Agent Study Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Implements structured multi-agent workflows which directly map to recent hackathon-winning architectures in education tech.

ideas.pitch: A verified digital portfolio platform for college clubs to showcase software MVPs, deployment links, and video demos with automated README evaluation.
ideas.title: Campus Asset and Project Showcase Registry
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a practical utility tool built directly for student communities like SOSC to curate project submissions post-hackathon.
